title: Square every element
starter:
%in  = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%out = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=1
# out[i] = in[i] * in[i] for every i in 0..5. The starter only does i = 0.
%v   = shrink %in 0 shape=[]
%x   = load %v
%sq  = mul %x %x
%o   = shrink %out 0 shape=[]
%s   = store %o %sq
%out1 = after %out %s

samples.label:
buffer slot 0 starts as [1 2 3 4 5 6]
final contents of slot 1

buffer slot 0 starts as [-3 3 -1 1 0 7]
final contents of slot 1

hints: Replace the constant 0 offsets with a counter: `%i = range 6`.
Use `%i` as the offset of both views. The store then depends on `%i`, so it has to be repeated: `%e = end %s %i`.
The `after` must sequence the whole loop, not the single store: `%out1 = after %out %e`.

answer.code:
%in  = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=0
%out = buffer 6 dtype=i32 slot=1
%i   = range 6
%v   = shrink %in %i shape=[]
%x   = load %v
%sq  = mul %x %x
%o   = shrink %out %i shape=[]
%s   = store %o %sq
%e   = end %s %i
%out1 = after %out %e
answer.explain: A `range 6` counter replaces the fixed index, `end %s %i` repeats the store for every i, and `after %out %e` names the buffer after the whole loop. The bounds check passes because the range's interval is [0, 5] and both buffers hold 6 elements. Squares wrap like any i32 mul.
